rules: Reuse the hash-identified public supplier manifest as acquisition and notice provenance data, not as the identity of a new candidate.
Require exact toolchain versions and every registry package/checksum in the candidate capture Cargo.lock to match the recorded supplier data.
Extract verbatim notices from their exact supplier members. Preserve previously published hash-verified derived notice bytes and their recorded derivations.
Keep all six recorded Qt source modules and all locked Cargo sources conservatively; source inclusion alone does not mean runtime deployment.
Require explicit review when inputs or payload suppliers change. This recipe does not decide legal applicability.
